name: pi-sarvam-provider
description: Pi coding-agent extension that registers Sarvam AI as a model provider and adds the compatibility shims its OpenAI-compatible endpoint needs (role/content fixes, tool-argument remapping, 403 retry, and a 256KB request-size guard).
